compiled_state.title: Resilience-harden two-tier flow: tristate gate contract + durable --resume + universal escalation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
As a maintainer, I want the two-tier flow's PROVENANCE/AVAILABILITY mechanism to fail RESILIENTLY -- distinguishing "couldn't compute" from "review violation," and self-healing the deterministic state stalls -- so the flow stops collapsing every mechanical edge case into a hard block needing manual git surgery, WITHOUT ever weakening the "every commit reaching main is reviewed" guarantee.

(SPLIT: the version-bump KEEP design and the dangling-matcher 6-finding correctness pass were carved out of the original bundle into their own tickets per panel topology -- see Dependencies.)

## SECURITY GUARDRAIL (non-negotiable, every DD)
Resilience applies ONLY to mechanical/indeterminate states (uncomputable diff, transient API error, stale --resume state). It MUST NEVER auto-resolve "is this code reviewed" -- a genuine coverage/provenance violation stays a hard FAIL. Every DD states its class and asserts it cannot flip a real review violation to PASS.

## Done Definition

- DD1 (Tristate gate contract): codify the decidability lattice PASS / FAIL / INDETERMINATE in a REVIEW-SPECIFIC contract doc, seeded from the landed plugins/dso/scripts/ci/precondition-gate.sh (the a85d/S1 exit-78 mode-gate) -- NOT enforcement-gate-contract.md (that is the binary local-vs-ci-pr hook-skip contract, a different concern; plan SS3/SS4). The lattice rule (LOAD-BEARING, plan SS2): FAIL is the safe bottom; when PASS vs INDETERMINATE cannot be distinguished by evidence at decision time -> resolve to FAIL; retry ONLY when the cause is OBSERVABLY transient (5xx / rate-limit / timeout readable from the error); NEVER PASS on inferred-benign (an empty diff is never assumed net-zero). Retrofit the review-coverage / dangling / llm-review-dispatch gates to emit the tristate -- NAME the existing fail-closed sites (review-coverage-invariant.sh, llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh), do not invent new ones. Generalizes a85d's exit-78 mode-gating.

- DD2 (Durable-truth --resume): --resume reconstructs pipeline state from GitHub PR state + git history (level-triggered), treating /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*.json as a CACHE, not the source of truth. Eliminates the stale/cross-version state stall (INC-015); builds on acb17a3cef. INC-008 GUARD (LOAD-BEARING): an incomplete/partial/truncated read of GitHub state (e.g. API pagination cut short) is INDETERMINATE -- NEVER treated as authoritative-empty; acting on partial state as if it were "no PRs" re-creates the very stall this kills.

- DD3 (Universal in-channel escalation): INDETERMINATE verdicts from any gate route to the existing /dso:fp-recovery escape valve so there is always an in-channel recovery rather than manual git surgery. (Optional stretch: a level-triggered drift reconciler for ruleset <-> required-checks.txt parity + orphan staged-* pruning -- split to its own story if it grows; YAGNI for now.)

## Live verification + experiments
- Indeterminate: force a token blip mid-coverage-walk -> gate emits INDETERMINATE -> bounded retry -> PASS (no wedge, no silent green).
- INC-008: inject a truncated GitHub PR list into --resume reconstruction -> state resolves INDETERMINATE (re-fetch/escalate), NOT authoritative-empty; no duplicate staged-* ref re-created.
- Escalation: an INDETERMINATE verdict routes to fp-recovery with an actionable in-channel message (no manual git surgery).
- Security: attempt to launder an un-reviewed code change through every new path (INDETERMINATE retry, escalation, durable-resume reconstruction) -> all still BLOCK. The guardrail holds.

## Course-correction trigger
If any resilience/self-healing path can be shown to flip a genuine review violation to PASS, STOP immediately -- revert that path to hard-block. Resilience is valid only while the guardrail holds.

## Dependencies / sequencing
- depends_on: 7b77 (S2 -- DD1 retrofits the coverage gate), 29e7 (S4 -- DD1 retrofits the dangling gate; 29e7 now also carries the 6-finding matcher correctness pass that completes it, landing on PR #631). a85d/S1 is done -- DD1 generalizes its exit-78 mode-gating.
- depends_on: 4ba5 (bug -- empty-diff disambiguation: classification-time routing of a version-only clean merge BEFORE the empty check; an empty diff is DETERMINISTIC not transient -> classify/INDETERMINATE, never auto-block. Prerequisite for DD1's llm-review-dispatch tristate).
- blocks: 0cd7 (S5 -- its review-gate summary depends on DD1's tristate).
- SIBLINGS (carved out of the original bundle): the version-bump KEEP story and the dangling-matcher pass (folded into 29e7). The linear-history cutover is a separate ADR-0020-gated deferred story (Story B), sequenced before story 7 (3ee4 enforce-flip).

REFINEMENT (round-1 canonical panel, 2026-06-04) — DD4 additions (override-propagation):
(i) LIVENESS TEST (fitness + historical TOP finding): add a CI test — sibling to 0cd7 DD6's 3-consumer equivalence test — that injects a known admin-exempt SHA and asserts review-coverage-invariant treats it as exempt IN THE CI ENVIRONMENT. It FAILS today because DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER is unset in review-coverage-invariant.yml. Wire it into required-checks.txt so the dead-wiring becomes a fail-closed machine check, not a human-noticed gap. Root cause of this session's friction = "checks shipped dormant; activation is an unguarded silent-skip"; this test is the antidote.
(ii) SUB-PR vs PR2 (G-B): FP-recovery must ael_append the cleared SHAs REGARDLESS of whether it cleared a sub-PR (review-sub-pr — the COMMON case, where the LLM actually runs) or the main PR2 (llm-review). A sub-PR FP-recovery that does not append leaves PR2's base-excluding coverage walk un-credited. FP-RECOVERY-WORKFLOW.md currently keys ONLY on llm-review (bug 2195 / G-B) — DD4 must cover the review-sub-pr path explicitly.
(iii) .closure-key CI PROVISIONING (sub-gap G-A) as an EXPLICIT item: the coverage-invariant CI job needs the HMAC key file (the closure-key, in the tickets orphan) to VALIDATE ledger entries. This is a "set a secret in one workflow" step that silently no-ops if missed — same failure shape as the unset env var. Make it a gated checklist item under 3ee4 (P8b).

comments.body:
DD4 UNIT 5 + SECURITY CONDITIONS (canonical panel, 2026-06-04). The override-propagation has TWO Goal-1 consumers; units 1-3 wired only review-coverage-invariant. verify-session-provenance.sh drives the llm-review DISPATCH and does NOT honor the ledger, so an FP-recovered SHA (failed-then-overridden covering PR) stays UNPROVENANCED -> PR2 llm-review re-reviews -> SECOND override (proven live on #634). Bug c9e9.

UNIT 5 = make verify-session-provenance treat an HMAC-valid admin-exemption SHA as provenanced (additive, fail-closed: `if [[ -n "$LEDGER" ]] && ael_sha_is_exempt ...; then classify provenanced; continue` — placed AFTER the clean-merge exempt (~:408)/cache, BEFORE the covering-PR API lookup; mirror review-coverage-invariant.sh:179; keep the call INSIDE the if-condition so verifier `set -e` cannot abort/skip the marker; never else-classify-as-provenanced). Set DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER in the provenance CI step.

HARD SECURITY CONDITIONS (panel SOUND-WITH-CONDITIONS — gate G-A key-provisioning + unit 5 + the enforce-flip on ALL of these):
- C1 CODE-ENFORCE THE OPUS-GATE (showstopper): fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh currently trusts --reviewer-hash as an opaque string. It MUST verify the hash against a real reviewer-findings.json (0 critical/important/fragile, --reviewer-hash integrity) BEFORE ael_append. Else anyone with the key can sign a forged "reviewed-equivalent" entry (rule:fabrication class). Load-bearing fix — provenance decides whether the LLM runs at all.
- C2 SCOPE provenance to honor ONLY exempt_by=fp-recovery/admin-class entries (ael_append currently accepts ANY exempt_by).
- C3 KEY BOUNDARY: establish (and document the threat model) that the routine dev/sub-agent identity cannot BOTH read the closure-key (in the tickets orphan) AND invoke ael_append — a control, not discipline. Provenance+coverage must not become a single point of failure on the key; keep a key-independent backstop OR an authorizing ADR (ADR-0013 named-narrow-exception model).
- C4 NO-DORMANT for provenance: extend no-dormant-security-check to assert the provenance step sets DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER (P-AEL-PROVENANCE), else the new consult ships dormant.
- C5 FORCE-REVIEW: assert/test that staged-* head branches do NOT match sub-pr-branch-patterns.txt's force-review regex (force-review re-dispatches independent of provenance; would re-wedge).
FAST-FOLLOW (do NOT block the flip): extract a shared `is_sha_review_equivalent` predicate (clean-merge -> ledger-HMAC -> covering-PR-proven) consulted by BOTH coverage-invariant and provenance, under 0cd7/DD6's 3-consumer equivalence test (duplication debt documented at verify-session-provenance.sh:371-377,640-647).
NOTE: the EXISTING coverage-ledger consult (units 1-3) is also dead in CI today (closure-key not provisioned — 0 refs in .github/). Provisioning the key (G-A) arms BOTH consumers simultaneously, so C1-C3 gate G-A.

comments.body: C3 DESIGN CONVERGED + ACCEPTED (ADR-0021, 2026-06-04). 3-lens panel (accuracy/historical/fitness) + a convergence re-review. Invariant: ledger-honoring is reviewed-equivalent ONLY while the signing key is agent-unreachable. Convergence verdict APPROVED (all 3 criticals resolved, no new criticals). Migration moot: committed ledger has 0 data rows. NEXT: implement Part 1 (ael_key_file fail-closed + RED test + header rewrite + do-not-restore guard + FP-RECOVERY Step 5c edit) -> this is the C3 precondition that unblocks G-A.

comments.body: ARCHITECTURE PIVOT (2026-06-04, ADR-0022, supersedes ADR-0021 + the HMAC-ledger). Maintainer direction: the bypass-actor is a designated human admin merging via the GitHub UI; no persistent admin PAT. The HMAC-signed ledger (requires someone to SIGN each exemption) is replaced by an IDENTITY-BASED exemption: a SHA is reviewed-equivalent iff its covering merged PR's merged_by.id is in the configured bypass-actor SET (ruleset.bypass_user_ids, default = ruleset.bypass_user_id). Forge-proof by construction: the agent is current_user_can_bypass:never -> cannot merge a failing PR -> cannot be merged_by on a bypass; merged_by is server-set. Satisfies the v4/2730 anti-self-attestation lesson by a STRONGER means (no key to police). 3-lens panel (accuracy/historical/fitness) + convergence review -> APPROVED/converged, no integrity regression (all failure modes fail CLOSED), net deletion of the HMAC subsystem. RETIRES: admin-exemption-ledger.sh, fp-recovery-record-exemption.sh, .admin-exemption-ledger (inert, 0 rows, not on main), DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_KEY_FILE/gap G-A, C1/C2/C3, P-AEL/P-AEL-PROVENANCE, the two-tier ordering precondition. ADDS: merged_by.id read in the 2 covering-PR filters + merged_by∈set check replacing ael_sha_is_exempt at the 2 gates; bypass set config; merged_by in the audit sweep; P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT liveness gate (drives the production filter, both polarities). TRADE-OFF (explicit): C1 'cleared review before bypass' moves from preventive (code-enforced) to detective (annotation + non-blocking audit sweep) — accepted (trusted-human bypass-actor). NEXT: implement (TDD). Also update 3ee4 P8c prereq item 3 (S-11 ledger -> identity-based).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: PANEL-APPROVED DEVIATION (ADR-0022 rev.3, 2026-06-04): live on PR #642 the identity exemption was found NON-FUNCTIONAL — a real bug. ROOT CAUSE: GitHub's /commits/{sha}/pulls LIST endpoint OMITS merged_by (returns the simple PR representation; merged_by=null, verified live). ADR-0022 rev.2's 'merged_by rides the list object -> zero new API calls' was FALSE; the code read null -> never exempted. The original 4-reviewer panel (incl. the accuracy lens) ASSERTED the wrong API shape, and my tests modeled the fictional shape (merged_by in the list mock) so they were green against a non-existent API. FIX (rev.3): both gates (rc_sha_is_reviewed + verify-session-provenance G3) now evaluate the review-check FIRST and, ONLY on the bypass path (review failed/not_found), fetch merged_by via GET /pulls/{number} (--jq '.merged_by.id // empty'); budget-guarded (provenance side); fail-closed on empty/null/non-numeric/call-failure. Cost: zero extra calls on the reviewed path, one per covering PR on the rare bypass path. FULL 4-REVIEWER PANEL re-run (accuracy/historical/fitness + convergence): accuracy [audit-sweep bullet carried the same false assumption -> corrected], fitness [unguarded budget increment -> GH_BUDGET-guarded], historical [LOAD-BEARING: two parallel per-path tests are NOT the 0cd7-DD6/v4-anti-divergence shared-fixture equivalence test -> built test-identity-exemption-equivalence.sh driving BOTH gates over one fixture table, asserting identical verdicts, mutation-verified 4/4]. CONVERGENCE: APPROVED. Tests: equivalence 4/4, identity 3/3, provenance-admin-exempt 4/4, provenance 35/35, coverage-invariant 13/13. TRACKED FOLLOW-UPS (not blocking this fix): (1) P-IDENTITY-EXEMPT liveness gate still unbuilt — its absence is WHY this shape bug reached #642 (a CI liveness test injecting merged_by==bypass would have caught it pre-land); land before the 3ee4 enforce-flip. (2) lib-path GitHub calls are OUTSIDE the CF-6 budget envelope (asymmetric vs provenance) — note for 7b77. LESSON: list endpoints carry only SHA-identity fields; per-resource facts need the single-GET (already documented in the squash/rebase covering-PR doctrine at verify-session-provenance.sh:~327).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: LIVE REPRO of the stale-state / wrong-branch stall DD2 targets (2026-06-04, landing 7b77): merge-to-main on the 7b77 feature branch mis-detected the CURRENT branch as a leftover staged-* branch (staged-0b51459, the defense-mirror promotion that had just merged) and tried 'gh pr create' for PR2 staged->main, which failed 'No commits between main and staged-0b51459...' (that staged content was already on main). Root cause: a previous promotion left the worktree checked out on its staged-* branch AND left a /tmp/merge-to-main-state-*.json for it; the next merge-to-main picked up the wrong branch/state instead of starting fresh on the feature branch. Recovery was manual: rm the stale state files for the merged promotions, checkout the feature branch, rebase onto current origin/main, re-run. This is the INC-015 class (state file as source of truth) that DD2's 'reconstruct from GitHub PR state + git history, treat /tmp as cache' design fixes — AND argues for merge-to-main to (a) assert the current branch is the intended feature branch before the PR1 phase, and (b) garbage-collect state files for already-merged staged-* branches.
